WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    f.sale_date,
    CAST(SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(f.sale_date), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    s.region,
    f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web shop and training store
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'  -- exclude test articles
)
SELECT
  region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 8 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 9 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_september_2024
FROM sales_data
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

-- Control total: net sales (excluding VAT) before returns by region for Aug-Sept 2024
WITH sales_control AS (
  SELECT
    s.region,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) AS month,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date)
)
SELECT
  region,
  month,
  net_sales,
  ROUND(net_sales * 1.255, 2) AS imputed_gross_with_25p5_vat
FROM sales_control
ORDER BY region, month

-- Check VAT rate composition and verify gross amount calculation
WITH rate_check AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) AS month,
    f.vat_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) AS total_gross,
    SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS total_vat_collected
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date), f.vat_rate
  ORDER BY month, f.vat_rate
)
SELECT
  month,
  vat_rate,
  line_count,
  ROUND(total_net, 2) AS total_net,
  ROUND(total_gross, 2) AS total_gross,
  ROUND(total_vat_collected, 2) AS total_vat_collected
FROM rate_check

-- Verify grand total and net sales control
SELECT
  'GROSS SALES' AS metric,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_total,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS combined_total
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'NET SALES' AS metric,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_total,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS combined_total
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
